categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three primary business segments: (1) Smart Grid Equipment - including intelligent electrical switchgear, smart meters, and power information collection systems; (2) New Energy Charging and Battery Swapping - including charging piles, charging stations, and battery swapping systems; (3) Energy Storage - including energy storage converters, battery modules, and integrated energy storage systems. The company provides comprehensive solutions across the entire value chain from research and development to manufacturing, engineering design, construction, and operation and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear manufacturing, C-GIS intelligent ring main unit design and production, smart meter and power information collection system development based on 4G/5G and IoT communication technologies, large-capacity liquid-cooled fast charging technology, V2G bidirectional charging technology, and energy storage system integration with dual-directional converters. Production methods employ digitalized management systems including PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), intelligent production lines with automated quality detection, and modular design approaches for customized manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include State Grid Corporation of China and its subsidiaries, new energy vehicle manufacturers, public transportation operators, logistics companies, industrial parks, and commercial charging operators. End markets served include urban and rural power distribution systems, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, energy storage for power generation, grid, and industrial users, as well as specialized applications in rail transit, petrochemicals, and port construction.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions in China with major presence in Northeast China (Jilin), East China (Jiangsu, Zhejiang), North China (Beijing), Central China (Henan), and Southwest regions. Key manufacturing and R&D bases are located in Changchun, Nanjing, Hangzhou, and Changzhou. The company has 266 self-operated charging stations nationwide and is expanding international presence through participation in overseas exhibitions in Russia and other markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in component manufacturing (switchgear components, battery modules), midstream in equipment assembly and system integration (complete switchgear systems, charging stations), and downstream in service provision (charging station operation, maintenance services). The company integrates vertically from core component production through final system delivery and operational services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on: (1) Digital and intelligent upgrade of power grid equipment; (2) Development of high-power liquid-cooled fast charging and V2G technologies; (3) Energy storage system optimization for safety, efficiency, and cost reduction; (4) AI and IoT integration for smart operation and maintenance; (5) Establishment of collaborative innovation partnerships with research institutions including Chinese Academy of Sciences and leading universities; (6) International market expansion with emphasis on standardization and certification.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Product sales of electrical equipment and charging devices (approximately 97% of revenue); (2) Charging station operation services providing fast charging to commercial vehicles and public transportation; (3) Engineering design and installation services; (4) Operation and maintenance services. Revenue recognition follows customer control transfer for product sales and service completion for operational services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading supplier in China's smart grid equipment and new energy charging sectors. Key competitors include major electrical equipment manufacturers and emerging charging infrastructure operators. The company differentiates through: comprehensive product portfolio spanning multiple voltage levels, proprietary technologies in gas-insulated switchgear and fast charging, integrated solutions combining equipment and services, and established relationships with State Grid Corporation. The company holds multiple national certifications including National High-Tech Enterprise and Green Factory status.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported 2024 revenue of RMB 1.084 billion, representing a 5.21% decline from 2023 (RMB 1.143 billion). Net loss attributable to parent company shareholders was RMB 333 million in 2024 compared to net profit of RMB 25.5 million in 2023, primarily due to asset impairment charges of RMB 174 million. Total assets declined to RMB 3.346 billion from RMB 3.849 billion. The company maintains substantial equity of RMB 2.287 billion and operates with positive operating cash flow of RMB 393.5 million in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on: (1) Comprehensive integrated solutions combining equipment manufacturing with engineering services and operational management; (2) Advanced technology in environmentally-friendly gas-insulated switchgear and high-power liquid-cooled charging systems; (3) Established market position with State Grid Corporation as primary customer providing revenue stability; (4) Digital and intelligent capabilities including AI-powered safety monitoring and smart operation platforms; (5) Full-lifecycle service model from design through operation and maintenance; (6) Commitment to green and low-carbon solutions supporting China's dual carbon goals.
